```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

source("./r/transition_helpers.R")
```

## Load

```{r}
#| label: load
deploy_df <- read_csv(
  "./datasets/2026-10-05_deployment_analysis_phase_1.csv",
  na = "NULL",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
```

## Incidents

One row per incident, with missing states as `"None"`.

```{r}
#| label: incidents
incident_df <- deploy_df %>%
  distinct(
    incident_number,
    proqa_case_type,
    proqa_dispatch_code,
    cad_initial_incident_type_code,
    cad_incident_type_code,
    rms_incident_type_code
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(-incident_number, \(x) replace_na(x, "None")),
    proqa_dispatch_key = make_dispatch_key(proqa_case_type, proqa_dispatch_code)
  )
```

## Lookup tables

```{r}
#| label: lookups
proqa_lookup <- deploy_df %>%
  drop_na(proqa_dispatch_code) %>%
  transmute(
    state = make_dispatch_key(proqa_case_type, proqa_dispatch_code),
    category = proqa_dispatch_category,
    level = proqa_dispatch_level,
    subcategory = proqa_dispatch_sub_category
  ) %>%
  most_common()

# Only the final CAD type has a description column, so it also labels the
# initial type. A handful of initial codes never appear as a final type and
# will have no description.
cad_lookup <- deploy_df %>%
  drop_na(cad_incident_type_code) %>%
  transmute(
    state = cad_incident_type_code,
    description = cad_incident_type_description
  ) %>%
  most_common()

rms_lookup <- deploy_df %>%
  drop_na(rms_incident_type_code) %>%
  transmute(
    state = rms_incident_type_code,
    description = rms_incident_type_description,
    category = rms_incident_type_category,
    subcategory = rms_incident_type_subcategory
  ) %>%
  most_common()

# One table keyed by stage, because the same code can mean different things
# at different stages.
state_lookup <- bind_rows(
  proqa_dispatch = proqa_lookup,
  cad_initial = cad_lookup,
  cad_final = cad_lookup,
  rms = rms_lookup,
  .id = "stage"
)
```

## Phases

```{r}
#| label: phases
# 1: ProQA case type -> dispatch code
phase_1 <- incident_df %>%
  count_transition(proqa_case_type, proqa_dispatch_key, 1, "proqa_case_type", "proqa_dispatch")

# 2: CAD initial -> final type
phase_2 <- incident_df %>%
  count_transition(cad_initial_incident_type_code, cad_incident_type_code, 2, "cad_initial", "cad_final")

# 3: CAD final -> RMS type
phase_3 <- incident_df %>%
  count_transition(cad_incident_type_code, rms_incident_type_code, 3, "cad_final", "rms")

# 4: ProQA dispatch code -> RMS type
phase_4 <- incident_df %>%
  count_transition(proqa_dispatch_key, rms_incident_type_code, 4, "proqa_dispatch", "rms")
```

## Transition tables

```{r}
#| label: transitions
transition_df <- bind_rows(phase_1, phase_2, phase_3) %>%
  add_percent()

proqa_to_rms_transition_df <- bind_rows(phase_1, phase_4) %>%
  add_percent()
```
